QuestInfo.name: Peace for Perion
QuestInfo.1: Winston told you to deliver the news about Stumpy to 10 Boogies. Go tell her the good news.
QuestInfo.2: 10 Boogies is happy that you've made Perion safe again. Aww.

0.0: I believe you should return to town, and let 10 Boogies know that the matter is settled.
0.1: I say, that poor girl is so naive... At least now you can tell her the situation is well in hand. Let her stop worrying for a bit, what?\r\n#b(You will be moved to Perion if you accept.)#k

no.0: I see...you probably wish to rest after your hard battle. Take your time.

1.0: What happened? Did Winston find out what's causing all this?

yes.0: Oh, it was Stumpy? The big life-sucking tree? Wow... didn't expect that. But hey, thanks for saving the day!

npc.0: Tell 10 Boogies that Perion is safe. Don't let that poor girl worry so.
